title: Synthetic tile sorter
footer: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE / NOT A REAL SYSTEM
caption:
Synthetic renderer demonstration: a fictional tile sorter. No real system, benchmark or personal experience is represented.

Engine documentation:
https://www.remotion.dev/docs/
https://pillow.readthedocs.io/

sources.purpose: Renderer documentation; not evidence of a real tile sorting deployment

slides.title: A tiny sorting line
slides.intro: A fictional conveyor sorts colored tiles. This is a renderer demo, not a real system.

cards.label: RULE
cards.body: Blue goes left. Amber goes right.

slides.title: One color, one route
slides.intro: A rule maps each supported input to a named destination.

cards.label: BLUE
cards.body: Send the tile to the left bin.

cards.label: AMBER
cards.body: Send the tile to the right bin.

slides.title: Read, then route
slides.intro: The fictional machine reads a color before choosing the destination.

slides.title: An unknown color arrives
slides.intro: A purple tile has no route in this deliberately small example.

slides.title: Pausing has a cost
slides.intro: Stopping an unknown tile delays the line. Guessing could send it to the wrong bin.

slides.title: Count the destinations
slides.intro: The example starts with three tiles. The expected result is two left and one right.

slides.title: Replace the demo data
slides.intro: Write your own evidence-backed explanation in the editable JSON. Keep the example label when appropriate.

scenes.title: A small sorting line
scenes.summary: Three fictional tiles enter a conveyor.
phrases: This fictional conveyor has three colored tiles.
Two are blue, and one is amber.

scenes.title: Make the rule explicit
phrases: The rule sends blue tiles to the left.
Amber tiles go to the right bin.

scenes.title: Read before routing
scenes.note: The order is part of the example.
phrases: First the machine reads the color of a tile.
Then it applies the matching routing rule.

scenes.title: An unknown tile
scenes.summary: Purple is outside the small rule set.
phrases: Now imagine that a purple tile arrives.
This example pauses because purple has no route.

scenes.title: Show the trade-off
scenes.note: This is an illustrative design choice.
phrases: Pausing delays the line while someone checks the tile.
Guessing could quietly send it to the wrong bin.

scenes.title: Review the result
scenes.summary: Return to the original three tiles.
scenes.note: Inspect the exported images and captions.
phrases: For the original three tiles, check both bins.
There should be two on the left and one on the right.
